notes:
Big update!
- REAL TREES: no more green blobs. Tree crowns are made only of leaves, with branches inside and gaps you can see through; pine trees are needle sprays dusted with snow on the frost map
- LOG-SHAPED TRUNKS: tree trunks have deep bark ridges, a slight twist and lean, and roots that flare out at the base
- REAL HANDS: new tactical gloves with proper fingers that wrap the gun, a thumb, knuckle armour, leather palms and wrist cuffs, and your support hand now visibly grips the handguard; slimmer sleeves with real fabric weave
- BETTER FIRST-PERSON LOOK: your gun and hands are lit by the map's own sun and sky (dark at night, warm at sunset), reflect the sky, light up with each muzzle flash, and guns have parkerised metal, brushed steel and real wood grain (Ultra and Cinematic)
- REAL TREES AND STONE: trees are covered in real leaves that sway in the wind, with scanned bark on the trunks and fallen autumn leaves underneath; rocks are lumpy, mossy stone instead of smooth balls
- RUST: steel beams, pipes, barrels, trucks and lamp posts now rust in patches and streaks (Ultra and Cinematic)
- FIXED: you can shoot over rocks, low walls and other low cover; bullets used to stop at an invisible wall above them
- REAL GRASS: lawns and fields on every outdoor map now grow thick 3D grass that sways in the wind and bends where you walk, with wildflowers, plus dry grass tufts and pebbles on sand and dirt (High, Ultra and Cinematic; turn it off in Settings > 3D grass & ground detail)
- NEW NAME: the game is now called GRAVE SUITE, and the hotel map is The Grand Hotel
- REDESIGNED: Atom Village is now Maple Court (a blue house and a red house, a camper van and a storm cellar), and Castle Arena has new banners and towers
- NEW: privacy policy (PRIVACY.txt and on the website) and full credits for the 3D engine, characters, textures and font
- NEW: Prestige! At level 55 press PRESTIGE in the Multiplayer menu to start again from level 1 (up to Prestige 10, then Prestige Master). Each prestige gives a new emblem, 1000 BP and a Prestige Key that unlocks any gun for good
- REMOVED: the cards and the elixir bar (keys 6 to 9)
- RENAMED: guns, perks, scorestreaks, equipment and zombies machines now have the game's own names (for example the Arc Forge, the Mystery Crate, Lucky Gum, Castle Arena and Atom Village)
- FIXED: online Co-op Zombies with friends works again: the game used to start hidden behind the CLICK TO DEPLOY card and you could not play
- NEW animations: a real reload (the gun rolls over, your hand pulls the mag, slaps a fresh one in and racks the charging handle; shotguns load shell by shell), a sprint carry, a slide tilt, and other players and bots now really crouch, slide, lean into a sprint and reload
- MORE REALISM: the gun sways and trails your aim and breathes at rest, spent brass and shotgun shells fly out and tink on the floor, muzzle smoke, footsteps you can hear (yours and nearby enemies'), a landing thud and dip, and soldiers crumple and fall in different directions
- FIXED: you can equip keychains straight from the Shop: a new keychain goes on your class's main gun when you buy it, and the Shop has EQUIP, EQUIP ON ALL GUNS and REMOVE buttons
- FIXED: keychains now show up when you equip them. They hang off the left side of the gun, where you can see them in first person and in the Gunsmith, instead of hiding inside or behind the gun
- REAL gun sounds: every gun now has a sharp crack, a deep thump and its own bolt clatter, echoes off the arena walls outdoors and rings short in the hotel halls, and far-off shots sound muffled, come from the direction they were fired and arrive a moment late. Silenced guns like the AS VAL go quiet and mechanical, bolt-action snipers and the Model 870 work the bolt or pump after each shot
- REAL people on Ultra/Cinematic: soldiers and zombies are now rigged, photo-textured human models (3 soldiers, 4 zombified hotel guests), with a lighter far-away version so frame rate stays the same
- REAL scanned textures on Ultra/Cinematic: 20 photo-scanned surfaces (sand, sandstone, concrete, brick, wood, metal, grass, snow, marble, carpet, wallpaper and more) with real bumps and roughness on every map and in the hotel
- Outdoor maps are lit by a real photographed sky (HDRI) in daytime
- NEW: Controller support (Xbox, PlayStation and other gamepads): play and use every menu with a controller, with vibration, look speed and invert look settings
- 120 FPS mode: Target frame rate setting (Auto matches your screen, up to 240), dynamic resolution keeps it smooth, optional FPS counter
- More realistic graphics on Ultra/Cinematic: ambient occlusion adds soft contact shadows where people, objects and walls meet
- NEW: Player levels 1-55: earn XP from kills, assists, medals, objectives and wins, with level-up popups and your level on the scoreboard
- Level up to unlock guns, and level up each gun to unlock its attachments (guns you already used stay unlocked)
- Hip fire now spreads a little when you are not aimed in (more while moving or spraying)
- Parties are back in the desktop app
- NEW MODE: Search and Destroy: one life per round, plant or defuse the bomb at A or B (offline vs bots, and online)
- Realistic graphics on Ultra/Cinematic: proper tone mapping, physically based materials with surface detail, soft clouds and sun glow, modern HUD font
- Medals: Double Kill up to Kill Chain, Bloodthirsty to Nuclear streaks, First Blood, Headshot, Longshot, Payback, Ace and more, listed after each match
- Killcam: watch who got you, then click to respawn (spectate teammates in Search and Destroy)
- Banners: 22 calling cards (free, Shop, achievements) shown to the players you eliminate, plus PAYBACK kills
- NEW MAP: Grand Colosseum, a huge long arena packed with cover (also in online TDM and FFA)
- Phone layout fixed, online matches are now 5v5 to 100, set your own score (up to 1000) offline
- Bigger maps, plus two new ones: Farmstead and Downtown
- Play on phones and tablets (touch controls)
- 10 new guns incl. the Kar98k, new grenades and tacticals, sniper scopes
- 7 new scorestreaks, up to the Tactical Nuke
- Emotes, tracer rounds, keychains, new camos, codes, achievement rewards
- Parties, matchmaking, private matches and voice chat
- More realistic soldiers, zombies, guns and furniture
